newsitem.title: USA: Anchor Bancorp extends share repurchase.
newsitem.headline: Anchor Bancorp extends share repurchase.

text.p: Anchor BanCorp of Wisconsin Inc on Wednesday said its board of directors authorized the repurchase of an additional 231,098 shares, or five percent of its outstanding common stock.
The addition, approved January 15, brings the total number of shares authorized for repurchase to 403,998, the savings bank holding company said.
The additional purchases are expected to begin on or after January 24, 1997. The company will hold the repurchased shares as treasury stock available for general corporate purposes.
Earlier Wednesday, Anchor reported net income of $4.7 million, or $0.95 a share, for the third quarter ended December 31, compared with $3.5 million, or $0.65, in the year-earlier period.
Anchor shares were unchanged at 35-3/4 in early afternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
